verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed a working llms.txt at docs.supermemory.ai that indexes the markdown docs pages. Supermemory also documents agent-oriented resources: a docs-search remote MCP, an official agent skill that keeps agents on the real endpoints and auth, and a setup CLI for coding agents. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that agents consuming these docs produce correct integrations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
